description: Flashlight360 is a browser-based platform for educators and administrators to monitor and assess multilingual students' speaking and writing progress, providing scoring and feedback across defined language-skill areas.

description: FlipItPhysics is a commercial suite of short, sequential multimedia physics pre-lecture modules developed by the Physics Education Research Group at the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign, with embedded questions, automatic feedback, and tutorials.
title: FlipItPhysics

title: Flipped classroom model

description: An AI-powered learning platform described by Li et al.

description: An AI-powered web-based creative-coding environment developed by Tseng et al.
title: Flowcode
